LanguageData.LP_HellsCore.label: body of the Nine Hells
LanguageData.LP_HellsCore.description: The body of a devil of the Nine Hells: turns into black smoke and is banished to the Nine Hells when knocked down or killed (except bound ones or those in a planar anchor chain). Silver weapons deal ×1.5 damage; cold iron has no extra effect on it. Can't be tainted by the Abyss. Creations of the Nine Hells keep their contracts: bound ones' obedience never drops, and at 0 they only demand renegotiation.
LanguageData.LP_HellsCore.customEffectDescriptions.0: Downed or killed: banished to the Nine Hells.
LanguageData.LP_HellsCore.customEffectDescriptions.2: Bound ones' obedience never drops; at 0 they demand renegotiation and won't fight.
LanguageData.LP_FeyCore.label: fey body
LanguageData.LP_FeyCore.description: A creation of the Feywild: turns into a cold mist and returns to the Feywild when knocked down or killed (except bound ones). Cold iron weapons deal ×1.5 damage.
LanguageData.LP_FeyCore.customEffectDescriptions.0: Downed or killed: returns to the Feywild.
LanguageData.LP_CelestialCore.label: celestial body
LanguageData.LP_CelestialCore.description: A creation of the heavens: immune to abyssal taint; its attacks deal ×1.5 against demons, devils and undead; sees through invisibility and disguises (truesight). Turns into light and returns to the heavens when knocked down or killed.
LanguageData.LP_CelestialCore.customEffectDescription: Damage dealt against demons / devils / undead ×1.5.
Truesight: sees through invisibility and disguises (counts as a devil's eye).
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevilStature.label: chain devil build
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevilStature.description: A tall, chain-wrapped body: actual body size ×120%, drawn ×110%.
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevilChains.label: living chains
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevilChains.description: Natural weapons: chain lash (blunt 14); ability "Chain pull": one target within 4 cells takes a chain hit (14 blunt) and is yanked to its side.
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevilSubvert.label: turn skeletons
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevilSubvert.description: Within 6 cells of a hostile chain devil, a lich's necromantic constructs make a will (Wisdom) save (difficulty 13, base success 50%) or go berserk for 10 seconds. Each construct is checked at most once per hour.
LanguageData.LP_SkinChainDevil.label: iron-grey skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinChainDevil.description: A chain devil's iron-grey skin covered in chain marks.
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevilStature.label: bone devil build
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevilStature.description: A gaunt, bone-white body: actual body size ×150%, drawn ×130%, a skull-like head.
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevilTail.label: scorpion tail stinger
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevilTail.description: A scorpion-like tail stinger (pierce 16). Those stung make a Constitution save (difficulty 14, base success 45%); on failure, "bone venom": manipulation -20%, 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevilDread.label: fear aura
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevilDread.description: Enemies seeing it within 8 cells for the first time make a Wisdom save (difficulty 13, base success 50%) or are frightened for 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_SkinBoneDevil.label: bone-white skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinBoneDevil.description: A bone devil's pale skin stretched tight over the bones.
LanguageData.LP_HornedDevilStature.label: horned devil build
LanguageData.LP_HornedDevilStature.description: A hulking scale-armored body: actual body size ×180%, drawn ×140%, a pair of big horns and bat wings.
LanguageData.LP_HornedDevilFlame.label: hellfire throw
LanguageData.LP_HornedDevilFlame.description: Ability "Hellfire": hurl a ball of hellfire at a target within 10 cells (fire 15, may ignite), cooldown 30 seconds. Fire and burn damage ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_SkinHornedDevil.label: dark red scales
LanguageData.LP_SkinHornedDevil.description: A horned devil's dark red scales.
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesStature.label: erinyes body
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesStature.description: The body of an erinyes: looks just like a tall human, with red-black patterns crawling over the skin.
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesWings.label: black feathered wings
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesWings.description: A pair of jet-black feathered wings.
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesHunt.label: hunt
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesHunt.description: Ability "Hunt": mark an enemy for 3 days; the erinyes deals +15% damage to it. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesRope.label: binding rope
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesRope.description: Ability "Binding rope": one target within 8 cells makes a Dexterity save (difficulty rises with the erinyes's proficiency bonus and Dexterity; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success) or is bound for 4 seconds. Cooldown 2 hours.
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesResolve.label: avenger's will
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesResolve.description: Erinyes never fear: immune to fear effects (frightened, fear aura, frightful presence). Shooting and Melee talent +2.
LanguageData.LP_SkinErinyes.label: ashen grey skin
LanguageData.LP_AmnizuStature.label: amnizu build
LanguageData.LP_AmnizuStature.description: A tall, shriveled figure: actual body size ×140%, drawn ×120%, bald, small horns, pointed ears.
LanguageData.LP_AmnizuMind.label: touch of forgetting
LanguageData.LP_AmnizuMind.description: Humanlikes attacking an amnizu make an Intelligence save (difficulty 16, base success 35%); on failure, "forgetfulness": the highest skill -2 levels, restored after 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_SkinAmnizu.label: sallow skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinAmnizu.description: An amnizu's sallow skin like parchment.
LanguageData.LP_SatyrHorns.label: satyr horns
LanguageData.LP_SatyrHorns.description: A pair of backward-curving goat horns.
LanguageData.LP_SatyrHooves.label: goat hooves
LanguageData.LP_SatyrHooves.description: Furry goat legs and a pair of hooves: can't wear shoes or boots (clothing covering the feet). Anyone with this gene counts as a satyr.
LanguageData.LP_SatyrMagicResist.label: resistance of fey blood
LanguageData.LP_SatyrMagicResist.description: Psychic sensitivity ×0.6; Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma save success +10%.
LanguageData.LP_SatyrCharge.label: ram
LanguageData.LP_SatyrCharge.description: Ability "Ram": charge next to a target within 6 cells; the target makes a Strength save (difficulty rises with the satyr's proficiency bonus and Strength; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success) or falls for 1 second. Cooldown 4 hours.
LanguageData.LP_SatyrRevelry.label: revelry
LanguageData.LP_SatyrRevelry.description: Whenever the colony holds a party or wedding, satyrs get mood +10 (1 day).
LanguageData.LP_SatyrMusic.label: woodland musician
LanguageData.LP_DryadTree.label: tree bond
LanguageData.LP_DryadTree.description: The dryad is bound to an adult tree (growth ≥80%, not in a growing zone). Over 40 cells from the tree (or not on the same map): move speed and work speed ×0.5, mood -8. If the tree is cut, burned or dies: pain ×1.5, consciousness -30%, mood -30; she dies if she doesn't bind a new tree within 24 hours. Without a tree she drifts (mood -5 for 30 days). Ability "Bind to this tree".
LanguageData.LP_DryadTreeStride.label: tree stride
LanguageData.LP_DryadTreeStride.description: Ability "Tree stride": walk into a tree and come out next to another adult tree within 30 cells. Cooldown 2 hours.
LanguageData.LP_DryadBark.label: barkskin
LanguageData.LP_DryadBark.description: Skin with bark patterns: sharp armor +15%; Plants and Animals talent +4; fire and burn damage ×1.5.
LanguageData.LP_SkinDryad.label: bark-colored skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinDryad.description: A dryad's brown-green skin with bark patterns.
LanguageData.LP_HairDryad.label: new-leaf green hair
LanguageData.LP_RedcapStature.label: redcap build
LanguageData.LP_RedcapStature.description: A small body: actual body size ×60%, drawn ×70%; a blood-red pointed cap, heavy iron boots.
LanguageData.LP_RedcapBloodlustGene.label: bloodthirst
LanguageData.LP_RedcapBloodlustGene.description: Each melee hit adds a stack of "bloodlust" (+3 melee damage, up to 5 stacks = +15), cleared after an hour without a hit.
LanguageData.LP_RedcapStomp.label: heavy stomp
LanguageData.LP_RedcapStomp.description: Iron boots stomp on those lying on the ground: ×1.5 damage against downed targets.
LanguageData.LP_SkinRedcap.label: grey-brown skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinChangeling.label: unblemished pale
LanguageData.LP_SkinChangeling.description: A changeling's skin, pale without a hint of color.
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingFaces.label: thousand faces
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingFaces.description: Ability "Thousand faces": copy a visible humanlike's appearance (face, hairstyle, skin color, body type) and name for 24 hours; ends early when seen through by a devil's eye or a deva's truesight. Cooldown 1 day. Must be themself for a full day every 30 days, otherwise mood -6. Anyone with this gene counts as a changeling.
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingFluid.label: fluid appearance
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingFluid.description: A changeling's appearance is never fixed: beauty traits don't work on it; social talent +2.
LanguageData.LP_WildHunterAntlers.label: antlered helm
LanguageData.LP_WildHunterAntlers.description: An antlered helm grown together with the head.
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntLordCrown.label: huntmaster
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntLordCrown.description: Wild hunt leader: higher level; drops the true name scroll of the patron's agent when defeated.
LanguageData.LP_WildHunterPrey.label: prey
LanguageData.LP_WildHunterPrey.description: +30% damage against the prey the wild hunt is chasing.
LanguageData.LP_WildHunterSpear.label: fey lance
LanguageData.LP_WildHunterSpear.description: Natural weapon: fey lance (pierce 20, armor penetration 40%).
LanguageData.LP_SkinWildHunter.label: frost-white skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinWildHunter.description: A wild hunt rider's frost-crusted skin.
LanguageData.LP_DevaStature.label: deva body
LanguageData.LP_DevaStature.description: A tall angel: actual body size ×140%, drawn ×120%, platinum wings.
LanguageData.LP_DevaMace.label: radiant mace
LanguageData.LP_DevaMace.description: Natural weapon: radiant mace (blunt 16, plus 8 radiant damage). Anyone with this gene counts as a deva.
LanguageData.LP_DevaHealing.label: healing touch
LanguageData.LP_DevaHealing.description: Ability "Healing touch": heals a person's worst wound. Cooldown 8 hours (3 per day).
LanguageData.LP_SkinDeva.label: golden-gleaming skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinDeva.description: A deva's skin with a faint golden sheen.
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarStature.label: planetar body
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarStature.description: An angel twice the size of an ordinary person: actual body size ×200%, drawn ×160%, silver wings.
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarSword.label: celestial greatsword
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarSword.description: Natural weapon: celestial greatsword (cut 30, armor penetration 50%, plus 10 radiant damage).
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarWrath.label: celestial wrath
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarWrath.description: Ability "Celestial wrath": enemies within 8 cells take 30 radiant damage. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarBanish.label: dispel
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarBanish.description: Ability "Dispel": one outsider makes a Charisma save (difficulty 20, base success 15%) or is driven back to its plane; legendary bosses spend legendary resistance first. Cooldown 1 hour.
LanguageData.LP_SkinPlanetar.label: silver-gleaming skin
LanguageData.LP_SkinPlanetar.description: A planetar's skin with a silver sheen.
